author: reek
body: Radial (zoom) blur as a compute post-process. Each pixel walks the line from the screen centre out to itself, sampling the scene buffer at a sequence of shrinking scales and averaging -- so bright features smear into radial light streaks toward the centre. The scene is the bloom demo's three orbiting orbs, rendered by BloomSceneKernel into a buffer; this pass reads it through a storage-pointer helper parameter. Reference site's "radial blur" technique.

author: reek
body: Fold over the taps: scale the pixel's offset from centre down toward the centre, sample there, sum the chosen channel. buf is a storage pointer.
